'''December 2000 Parker tournament (23 December)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, CO on 23 December 2000. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1572">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-24-parker-co-12-23-00-the-next-chapterd1572/ parker-co-12-23-00-the-next-chapter], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 24 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-24-parker-co-12-23-00-the-next-chapterd1572/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Parker, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 24
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Brian Hunter gives the turnout as 24 players; Chris Fanchi says he finished 4th 'out of about 28'.<ref name="tr-d1572" />
